name: synthetic_v1
description: Small, hand-labelled SYNTHETIC corpus for testing the PaperTrail AI pipeline. The passages were written for this dataset and are not real research findings. Each page holds exactly one passage, so gold labels refer to (document, page).

D1.title: Synthetic Study A: Regularisation in Image Classifiers
pages: Overfitting occurs when a model learns noise in the training data instead of the underlying pattern. Many regularisation techniques have been proposed to address it.

In our experiments on CIFAR-10, adding dropout with probability 0.5 reduced the gap between training and test accuracy from 15 to 4 percentage points, indicating reduced overfitting in these convolutional networks.
Batch normalization reduced the number of training epochs needed to reach 90 percent accuracy by 40 percent in our setup.

D2.title: Synthetic Study B: Regularisation at Scale
pages: For language models with more than one billion parameters trained on web-scale data, dropout did not reduce overfitting; validation loss was unchanged or slightly worse with dropout enabled.
Prior work (Smith et al., 2014) reported that dropout reduces overfitting in small neural networks trained on limited data.

D3.title: Synthetic Study C: Learning-Rate Warmup
pages: Linear learning-rate warmup over the first 2,000 steps prevented early training divergence in all transformer training runs we performed.
With the Adam optimizer and small batch sizes, warmup had no measurable effect on final accuracy, whereas with large batch sizes warmup improved final accuracy by two points.

D4.title: Synthetic Study D: Coral Reef Monitoring
pages: Across twelve monitored reefs, coral bleaching events increased in frequency as sea surface temperature rose during the observation period.

D5.title: Synthetic Study E: Data Augmentation
pages: Random cropping and horizontal flipping improved test accuracy by three points on ImageNet subsets and reduced overfitting of the image classifiers.
Augmentation might also help speech recognition models, although we did not test this hypothesis.

D6.title: Synthetic Study A (preprint version)
pages: In the preprint experiments on CIFAR-10, dropout with probability 0.5 reduced overfitting of the convolutional networks, shrinking the train-test accuracy gap to 4 points.
